prompt: Repo: this directory (static site). Plan: specs/2-share-previews/plan.md; spec: specs/2-share-previews/spec.md. Your task: Task 2 only (R1, R2, R3). Add head metadata to `index.html` and the six `projects/*.html` pages: one `` with the page's absolute URL (`https://www.peterkernohan.com/` for home, `https://www.peterkernohan.com/projects/.html` for case studies); `og:title` and `og:description` exactly equal to the page's existing `` and meta description, `og:url` = canonical, `og:type` (`website` home, `article` case studies), `og:site_name` = `Peter Kernohan`, `twitter:card` = `summary_large_image`; `og:image`: absolute `https://www.peterkernohan.com/...` URL; home uses `/assets/og-card.png`, a case study its own first `<img>` (percent-encoding preserved), else the card. Only `<head>` changes. Acceptance: `python3 -m pytest -q tests -k "canonical or open_graph"`. `.claude/fast-test.sh` must be green when you finish (it already sets aside tests that belong to later tasks). Commit your work as one commit when done.

grader.command: git diff --quiet $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) -- tests && python3 -m pytest -q tests -k 'canonical or open_graph or broken'
